note: CONSTRAINT register: every environment limit that touches the implementation plan, with the current-fact evidence, what it prevents, whether it is provable in this environment (provable_here) or only externally (external_procedure + the evidence schema an external run must produce), the acceptance steps it touches and the sequence steps that run under it.  External rows are the inputs another environment must supply; they never block a delta from producing every proof this environment can run.

rows.constraint: no public HTTPS origin is reachable from this environment (githack and GitHub Pages refused at CONNECT; raw.githubusercontent serves text/plain + nosniff + sandbox CSP)
rows.prevents: executing a generated bundle or the Factory on a public secure-context origin
rows.external_evidence_schema: public-https.json: {url, served bundle.json identity, transfers exact, loss/reselection, environment identity} produced by host/harness/webapp-probe.mjs --url
rows.note: loopback is a secure context and carries every proof this environment can run; it is never substituted for the public run

rows.constraint: storage is best-effort: navigator.storage.persist() returns false in the Chromium 141 headless shell; installed-Factory durability never observed
rows.prevents: proving that the installed Factory's objects and pointers survive storage pressure
rows.external_procedure: run the D28 durability probe (written by FC-1 beside the seed harness) in an installed full Chrome: navigator.storage.persist() after installation, then a storage-pressure or restart cycle
rows.external_evidence_schema: durability.json: {product, revision, installed: boolean, persisted: boolean, quota, usage, objects_after_restart: boolean}
rows.note: full Chrome grants durable storage to installed or important sites; the headless shell answers every permission ASK

rows.constraint: only the Chromium headless shell is installed: web-app installation (the manifest's install prompt) is never observed
rows.prevents: observing installation of the Factory as an app (the L0 install claim)
rows.external_procedure: install the seed origin in a full Chrome and record the installation (beforeinstallprompt, display-mode standalone) with the identity capture
rows.external_evidence_schema: install.json: {product, revision, display_mode, installed: boolean, identity}
rows.note: launch offline and restart survival are proven without installation (P01, P03); installation itself is a UA behaviour

rows.constraint: no GPU device node: only the SwiftShader CPU fallback adapter is ever observed
rows.external_procedure: run tests/physical/run-webapp.mjs on a host with a GPU device node
rows.note: not needed by the Factory itself; generated apps only

rows.constraint: no rustc for a wasm host ships and no cranelift backend is installed; the toolchain hosts are refused by the egress policy
rows.prevents: measuring or running a hosted toolchain (B1/B5) here; B4 and B3 can be measured and built here
rows.external_procedure: an environment with network access to the toolchain sources measures a wasm-hosted rustc (size, memory, time to compile the pinned workspace); the exit criteria are written by FC-7
rows.external_evidence_schema: rust-build-measure.json per candidate: {candidate, artifact_size, peak_rss, wall_time, identity_or_behavioural_oracle, result}
rows.note: the native pinned build is measurable here and bounds any hosted toolchain from below

rows.constraint: Linux x86_64 only; no other platform observed
rows.prevents: claims about Android, ChromeOS, macOS or Windows defaults
rows.external_procedure: run tests/reprove/identity.mjs and the physical probes on another platform
rows.note: closure on Linux is closure; other platforms are STALE_IF dimensions, not blockers

rows.constraint: the egress policy refuses the published authority hosts and the shared static hosts; GitHub (REST, git) is reachable
rows.prevents: reopening published renderings; hosting on githack or Pages
rows.external_procedure: none needed for closure; the authority pins are source-verified at the tips
rows.note: remote sync (L4) can use GitHub REST, which answers with CORS from here

rows.constraint: one Chromium version (141) only: seed and generation behaviour across a browser update is unobservable
rows.prevents: proving that an activated generation survives a browser update
rows.external_procedure: repeat the FC-1 failure matrix and the FC-8 experiment on the next Chromium; STALE_IF browser.version re-selects every generation claim
rows.external_evidence_schema: the same records under the new browser identity
rows.note: a seed incompatibility would be a P14-class failure

rows.constraint: shared / threaded Wasm is unadmitted (presence only); cross-origin isolation is grantable by the SW
rows.prevents: nothing the Factory needs: the kernel is single-threaded
rows.note: kept for completeness; no closure delta admits threads

rows.constraint: loopback secure context with every storage and confinement primitive available: OPFS, IndexedDB, CacheStorage, service workers, Web Locks, opaque frames, wasm64, git identities, atomic pointers
rows.prevents: nothing: this is what IS provable here (the positive constraint every FC delta runs under)
rows.note: every proof of the series except the public origin, durability under installation, hosted toolchains and browser updates runs here

rows.constraint: the host judge and toolchain are present here: cargo 1.94.1 + nightly-2026-09-24, node 22, git, Playwright
rows.prevents: nothing: the RUST_BUILD epoch of every imported object and the judge of every delta exist here
rows.note: acceptance steps 3-4 are executable here ONLY through this host, which is exactly what closure must remove
